**Analysis Trail – Project: SUPERFANCY Component UUID: AB1010CD Vulnerability ID: ef903ac-893-f00** | Step | Description | Key Findings | Actions Taken | Notes | |------|-------------|--------------|---------------|-------| | **1. Vulnerability Identification** | • The vulnerability was flagged by the automated scanning tool (SAST/DAST) during the latest build cycle.
• It appears as a “Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS)” issue in the component identified by UUID AB1010CD. | • The scanner detected unsanitized user input being reflected in the `title` attribute of an `` tag on the `/profile` page.
• The payload used was ``. | • Logged the finding in the issue tracker (Jira ticket #SF-12345).
• Assigned to the front‑end dev team. | The vulnerability is marked as **High** severity due to potential data exfiltration. | | **2. Contextual Analysis** | • Reviewed the component’s codebase (Git commit `abcd1234`).
• Identified the source of the data: `props.userProfile.title` passed directly to the DOM. | • No sanitization or encoding applied before rendering.
• The component is reused across multiple routes (`/profile`, `/dashboard`). | • Noted that the same pattern exists in other components (`AB1020EF`). | The issue is not isolated; it may affect other parts of the application. | | **3. Threat Modeling** | • Assessed potential attack vectors: phishing, credential theft, session hijacking.
• Determined that an attacker could inject malicious scripts that run in the context of the logged‑in user. | • Attack surface includes any endpoint that accepts user‑generated titles.
• The vulnerability could lead to full compromise of the user’s session. | • Classified the risk as **Critical** for the affected user base. | The threat model aligns with OWASP Top 10 – A7: Cross‑Site Scripting. | | **4. Mitigation Strategy** | • Implemented output encoding using `DOMPurify` for all user‑supplied strings.
• Updated the component to use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` only after sanitization. | • Added a utility function `sanitizeTitle()` that wraps `DOMPurify.sanitize()`.
• Updated unit tests to cover XSS scenarios. | • Pushed a hot‑fix branch `fix/xss-title-AB1010CD`. | The fix also includes a lint rule to disallow raw HTML injection without sanitization. | | **5. Verification & Testing** | • Ran regression tests on the affected component.
